text.p: Merrill Lynch said it had initiated coverage of Brazilian pulp and paper maker Cia. Suzano de Papel e Celulose with an accumulate rating in the intermediate and long terms.
-- It also said it estimates the company to report earnings of $0.26 per ADR in 1997 and $1.34 in 1998. The firm posted earnings of $0.08 per ADR last year, it added.
-- Analyst Thomas Mello Souza said in a report Suzano is Brazil's second largest integrated paper maker, with 1996 net revenues of 487 million reais.

-- He said "the combination of a low-cost wood fiber source and state-of-the-art mills makes Suzano one of the most competitive paper companies on the globe." He also said the company has proven in the past that it can be profitable despite very adverse market conditions.

The Merrill Lynch analyst expects pulp and paper prices to improve considerably in 1998. He also said Brazil is a rapidly developing market which could show sustained economic growth for a period of several years. Paper consumption in the country could grow five to six percent a year over the next few years, he added.
-- Suzano preferred were down 2.49 percent at 2.35 reais on the Sao Paulo bourse earlier.
